name: io.github.Servosity/cisco-duo-mcp
title: Cisco Duo MCP
description: Fix Duo MFA lockouts and see every MSP subaccount at once, from your AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Your Duo API hostname, e.g. api-XXXXXXXX.duosecurity.com (Duo Admin Panel > Applications > your Admin API application). For an MSP, use the parent account's hostname.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_IKEY
environmentVariables.description: Admin API integration key (ikey) from the same Admin API application.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_SKEY
environmentVariables.description: Admin API secret key (skey). Used only to sign each request; it is never sent to Duo.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default customer subaccount for every call (account ID, or exact name from accounts list); a tool call that names its own account-id overrides it. Leave blank to act on the account the keys belong to; the fleet tools always cover every subaccount.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a read-only server: lockout fix, phone-swap, enrollment chase, sync, import and export are hidden, and the API execute tool refuses every non-GET call. Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the full API root (for a test server). Leave blank; CISCO_DUO_API_HOST is the normal setting.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token that cisco-duo-mcp --transport http requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

environmentVariables.name: CISCO_DUO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Duo requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank unless you configured client profiles.
